2. Brief facts of the case of prosecution:-
The case of prosecution is that the accused running an event management company called Orchestra Solutions Pvt., Ltd., and CW.1 is running a company called Audio Plus.

The accused with the intention of cheating the CW.1, obtained Sound System Projector, lighting, LED Valas and other facility services worth of Rs.71.3 lakhs from 2017 to 2020 from CW.1 near Nisarga Hotel and issued blank cheques.
Out of these cheques, cheque No.000128 dated 17.08.2021 and cheque No.000127 dated 18.01.2022 got dishonoured due to insufficient funds when submitted for encashment.

The accused issued the cheques with the intention of C.C.
No.24119/2022 cheating the CW.1 and thus accused has committed the offences punishable U/s.420 R/w 34 of Indian Penal Code.
3. In response to court summons the accused No.1 appeared through his counsel Sri. N.K. and have been enlarged on bail.
Cognizance was taken for the alleged offences.
The prosecution papers have been furnished to the accused No.1 through his counsel as contemplated U/s 207 Cr.P.C. Heard before framing of Charges.
Charges were framed, read over and explained to the accused No.1 in Kannada language known to him, having understood the same he pleaded not guilty of offence and claimed to be tried.

Case against accused No.2 is split-up and registered against the accused No.2.
4.
As per the charge sheet the prosecution has cited 09 witnesses.
Out of these witnesses the prosecution has examined one witness and Ex.P-1 and Ex.P-2 are marked.
As the PW.1 being material witness turned hostile, other witnesses were dropped.
As there was no incriminating evidence against the accused No.1, statement of accused No.1 u/s. 313 of Cr.P.C. was dispensed.
Heard arguments of learned APP for the prosecution and learned counsel for the accused No.1.
Perused the entire materials on record.

sentences.text: The case of the prosecution is that the accused running an event management company called Orchestra Solutions Pvt., Ltd., C.C. No.24119/2022 and CW.1 is running a company called Audio Plus.

The accused with the intention of cheating the CW.1, obtained Sound System Projector,
lighting, LED Valas and other facility services worth of Rs.71.3 lakhs from 2017 to 2020 from CW.1 near Nisarga Hotel and issued blank cheques.
Out of these cheques, cheque No.000128 dated 17.08.2021 and cheque No.000127 dated 18.01.2022 got dishonoured due to insufficient funds when submitted for encashment.
The accused issued the cheques with the intention of cheating the CW.1 and thus accused has committed the offences punishable U/s.420 R/w 34 of Indian Penal Code.
10. To bring home the guilt of the accused No.1, the prosecution has examined CW.3 by name Ravichandra is the complainant as PW.1.
The PW.1 has deposed that the accused has not cheated.
He has further deposed that he do not know the contents of Ex.P.1 and Ex.P.2.
Ex.P.1 is the complaint and Ex.P.2 is the Mahazar.
As the PW-1 deposed adverse to the case of prosecution, the prosecution has treated the PW-1 hostile and cross-examined PW-1.
Though the learned APP for the prosecution cross-examined PW.1, nothing is elicited to prove the charges levelled against the accused.

Thus, the prosecution has failed to C.C. No.24119/2022 prove beyond reasonable doubt,
the charges levelled against the accused.

Thus, Point No.1 is answered in Negative.
11. Point No. 2:- For the aforesaid reasons, this court proceed to pass the following:
ORDER Acting U/s.248(1) of Cr.P.C. accused No.1 hereby Acquitted of the offences punishable U/s.420 R/w 34 of Indian Penal Code.
The bail bond and surety of the accused No.1 stands cancelled.
